pool: synthetic coverage profile, 40 deletions on one 300 kb contig
interpretation: Fixture pool contains few low-ratio windows, so matching is bounded well above zero. An absolute threshold set here would encode a fixture artefact, which is why tests/test_hardneg_giab.py asserts only the relative matched-vs-uniform claim.

pool: real hs37d5 alignment, 5364 truth deletions, 33548 confident intervals
interpretation: Real candidate pool is rich enough that matched negatives are essentially depth-indistinguishable from positives. Clears the 0.25 --max-offset guard by an order of magnitude.
Most of the genome sits at the reference depth ratio while a heterozygous deletion is near 0.5 and a homozygous one near 0. This is the separability the sampler exists to remove.
